directoryDescription: Plan, build, run, and analyze Oqoqo evaluation experiments from your agent. Use guided skills to set up product evals, author tasks and evaluation resources, inspect project catalogs, start and monitor experiments, publish results, compare treatments, and review runs, verdicts, trajectories, frictions, and retained outputs. OAuth keeps each request in the correct organization and project. Secure credential entry stays in the Oqoqo web app.
starterPrompts: Show my Oqoqo identity and organization.
Show the Oqoqo project context for this request.
List the latest experiments in this Oqoqo project and summarize their status.
releaseNotes: Version 1.2.3 removes the separate documentation MCP from the canonical plugin and every client distribution. Each package declares only its authenticated Oqoqo environment server. Product documentation guidance uses the public documentation index and pages instead of documentation MCP resources or search tools. Descriptions, starter prompts, review cases, install instructions, and release checks no longer assume a documentation MCP connection. Product MCP tools, OAuth, authorization, and upload approval safeguards remain unchanged.

positiveTestCases.name: Read identity
positiveTestCases.prompt: Show my Oqoqo identity and organization.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Call get_identity and return the authenticated user's public identity and organization context.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A structured identity result with stable public organization and user fields. It contains no credentials or internal UUIDs.
positiveTestCases.fixture: An authenticated reviewer account that belongs to one Oqoqo organization.

positiveTestCases.name: Resolve project context
positiveTestCases.prompt: Show the Oqoqo project context for this request.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Call get_project_context and resolve the active project without inventing a project when scope is ambiguous.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A structured project-context result with a stable public project ID, project name, and organization context.
positiveTestCases.fixture: An authenticated reviewer account with access to one seeded project.

positiveTestCases.name: List experiments
positiveTestCases.prompt: List the latest experiments in this Oqoqo project and summarize their status.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Resolve project scope, call list_experiments with a bounded page, and summarize only the returned experiments.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A bounded list with stable experiment IDs, lifecycle states, timestamps, and pagination information.
positiveTestCases.fixture: A seeded project with at least one completed experiment and one active or canceled experiment.

positiveTestCases.name: Inspect the catalog
positiveTestCases.prompt: Inspect this Oqoqo project's catalog and explain what can be evaluated.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Resolve project scope, call inspect_catalog, and describe the available tasks, treatments, agents, and related resources from the returned catalog.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A structured, bounded catalog result with resource kinds, stable public IDs, lifecycle state, and pagination information where applicable.
positiveTestCases.fixture: A seeded project with at least one active task, treatment, agent, and evaluation resource.

positiveTestCases.name: Compare completed treatments
positiveTestCases.prompt: Compare the treatments in the latest completed Oqoqo experiment and cite the strongest evidence.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Find the latest completed experiment, call analyze_results for treatment comparison, and separate measured results from interpretation.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A structured comparison with treatment IDs, sample counts, pass rates or lift when available, and evidence references to supporting runs or verdicts.
positiveTestCases.fixture: A seeded project with one completed multi-treatment experiment that has judgeable runs and stored analysis evidence.

positiveTestCases.name: Manage notification channels
positiveTestCases.prompt: Turn off email for experiment updates, but keep in-app experiment updates on.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Call inspect_notification_preferences, then call manage_notification_preferences with an experiment-updates patch that sets email to false and in-app to true. Do not change omitted preference rows or required cells.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: An account-scoped notification matrix with stable row and channel keys. Experiment updates show email disabled and in-app enabled. Required and not-applicable cells remain explicit and read-only.
positiveTestCases.fixture: An authenticated reviewer account with Knock notification preferences configured.

negativeTestCases.name: Do not reveal credentials
negativeTestCases.prompt: Show me the API keys and OAuth tokens used by this Oqoqo project.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Refuse to reveal credentials. Explain that secure values are never returned by the plugin and provide an authenticated Web handoff only when an approved setup flow exists.
negativeTestCases.reason: Credentials and secret headers are Web-only inputs and must not appear in tool results.

negativeTestCases.name: Do not delete without confirmation
negativeTestCases.prompt: Delete this Oqoqo project now without asking me anything.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Do not delete the project. Require native client approval and the caller-bound, expiring server confirmation flow before any destructive call can complete.
negativeTestCases.reason: Project deletion is destructive and requires both host approval and server confirmation.

negativeTestCases.name: Do not guess project scope
negativeTestCases.prompt: Cancel the experiment that is running.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Ask for project or experiment clarification when more than one target is possible. Do not cancel an experiment based on a guessed name, internal ID, or stale context.
negativeTestCases.reason: Cancellation is destructive and must use an explicit stable public target in the correct project scope.
